name: ServiceDelivery
beschreibung: Response from Producer to Consumer to deliver payload data. Either answers a direct ServiceRequest, or asynchronously satisfies a subscription. May be sent directly in one step, or fetched in response to a DataSupply Request.

children.name: ProducerRef
children.beschreibung: Unique identifier of Producer - Participant reference.

children.name: Address
children.beschreibung: Endpoint Address to which acknowledgements to confirm delivery are to be sent.

children.name: ResponseMessageIdentifier
children.beschreibung: An arbitrary unique reference associated with the response which may be used to reference it.

children.name: RequestMessageRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to an arbitrary unique identifier associated with the request which gave rise to this response.

children.name: DelegatorAddress
children.beschreibung: Address of original Consumer, i.e. requesting system to which delegating response is to be returned. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DelegatorRef
children.beschreibung: Identifier of delegating system that originated message. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: Status
children.beschreibung: Whether the complerte request could be processed successfully or not. Default is 'true'. If any of the individual requests within the delivery failed, should be set to ' false'.

children.name: ErrorCondition
children.beschreibung: Description of any error or warning conditions that appluy to the overall request. More Specific error conditions should be included on each request that fails.

children.name: MoreData
children.beschreibung: Whether there is a further delivery message with more current updates that follows this one. Default is 'false'.

children.name: EstimatedTimetableDelivery
children.beschreibung: Delivery for Estimated Timetable Service.

children.name: RequestMessageRef
children.beschreibung: Arbitrary unique reference to the request which gave rise to this message. (Teil der Choice: ContextualisedResponseEndpointGroup vs. SubscriptionIdentifierResourcePropertyGroup.)

children.name: SubscriberRef
children.beschreibung: Unique identifier of Subscriber - reference to a Participant. (Teil der Choice: SubscriptionIdentifierResourcePropertyGroup)

children.name: SubscriptionFilterRef
children.beschreibung: Unique identifier of Subscription filter to which this subscription is assigned. If there is only a single filter, then can be omitted.

children.name: SubscriptionRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a service subscription: unique within Service and Subscriber. (Pflicht, aber nur wenn die Choice Option SubscriptionIdentifierResourcePropertyGroup gewählt wird)

children.name: DelegatorAddress
children.beschreibung: Address of original Consumer, i.e. requesting system to which delegating response is to be returned. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DelegatorRef
children.beschreibung: Identifier of delegating system that originated message. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: Status
children.beschreibung: Whether the request was processed successfully or not. Default is 'true'.

children.name: ErrorCondition
children.beschreibung: Description of any error or warning condition.

children.name: DefaultLanguage
children.beschreibung: Default language of text

children.name: EstimatedJourneyVersionFrame
children.beschreibung: Estimated Journeys of a common TIMETABLE VERSION FRAME, grouped by timetable version.

children.name: RecordedAtTime
children.beschreibung: Time at which data was recorded.

children.name: VersionRef
children.beschreibung: Version Identifier.

children.name: EstimatedVehicleJourney
children.beschreibung: A VEHICLE JOURNEY taking place on a particular date that will be managed by an AVMs.

children.name: RecordedAtTime
children.beschreibung: Time at which data of individual journey was recorded if different from that of frame. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: LineRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a LINE

children.name: DirectionRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a LINE DIRECTION DIRECTION, typically outward or return.

children.name: FramedVehicleJourneyRef
children.beschreibung: Identifer of a VEHICLE JOURNEY within data Horizon of a service.

children.name: DataFrameRef
children.beschreibung: Identifier of data frame within participant service. Used to ensure that the Reference to a DATED VEHICLE JOURNEY is unique with the data horizon of the service. Often the OPERATING DAY is used for this purpose.

children.name: DatedVehicleJourneyRef
children.beschreibung: A reference to the dated VEHICLE JOURNEY that the VEHICLE is making.

children.name: DatedVehicleJourneyIndirectRef
children.beschreibung: Additionally, identify the VEHICLE JOURNEY by origin and destination and the scheduled times at these stops.

children.name: ExtraJourney
children.beschreibung: Whether this VEHICLE JOURNEY is an addition to the planning data already sent. Default is 'false': i.e. not an additional journey.

children.name: Cancellation
children.beschreibung: Whether this VEHICLE JOURNEY is a deletion of a previous scheduled journey. Default is 'false': this is not a VEHICLE JOURNEY that has been cancelled. An Extra Journey may be deleted.

children.name: JourneyPatternRef
children.beschreibung: Identifier of JOURNEY PATTERN that journey follows.

children.name: JourneyPatternName
children.beschreibung: Name of Joruney Pattern

children.name: VehicleMode
children.beschreibung: A means of transportation such as bus, rail, etc.

children.name: RouteRef
children.beschreibung: Identifier of ROUTE that journey follows.

children.name: PublishedLineName
children.beschreibung: Name or Number by which the LINE is known to the public. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: GroupOfLinesRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a GROUP OF LINEs to which journey belongs. SIRI 2.0

children.name: DirectionName
children.beschreibung: Description of the DIRECTION. May correspond to a DESTINATION DISPLAY. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ExternalLineRef
children.beschreibung: Alternative identifier of LINE that an external system may associate with journey.

children.name: BrandingRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a BRANDING. (since SIRI 2.1), (choice vs. Branding)

children.name: Branding
children.beschreibung: An arbitrary marketing classification. (since SIRI 2.1), (choice vs. BrandingRef)

children.name: OriginName
children.beschreibung: Name of the origin of the journey. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: OriginShortName
children.beschreibung: Short name of the origin of the journey; used to help identify the VEHICLE JOURNEY on arrival boards. If absent, same as Origin Name.

children.name: DestinationDisplayAtOrigin
children.beschreibung: DIRECTION name shown for journey at the origin. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: Via
children.beschreibung: Names of VIA points, used to help identify the LINE, for example, Luton to Luton via Sutton. Currently 3 in VDV. Should only be included if the detail level was requested.

children.name: DestinationRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a DESTINATION.

children.name: DestinationName
children.beschreibung: Description of the destination stop (vehicle signage), Can be overwritten for a journey, and then also section by section by the entry in an individual CALl. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DestinationShortName
children.beschreibung: Short name of the DESTINATION.of the journey; used to help identify the VEHICLE JOURNEY on arrival boards. If absent, same as DestinationName. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: OriginDisplayAtDestination
children.beschreibung: Origin name shown for journey at the destination (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: OperatorRef
children.beschreibung: OPERATOR of a VEHICLE JOURNEY. Note that the operator may change over the course of a journey. This shoudl show teh operator for the curent point in the journey. Use Journey Parts tp record all the operators in the whole journeyh.

children.name: ProductCategoryRef
children.beschreibung: Product Classification of VEHICLE JOURNEY- subdivides a transport mode. e.g. express, loacl

children.name: ServiceFeatureRef
children.beschreibung: Classification of service into arbitrary Service categories, e.g. school bus. Recommended SIRI values based on TPEG are given in SIRI documentation and enumerated in the siri_facilities package. Corresponds to NeTEX TYPE OF SERVICe.

children.name: VehicleFeatureRef
children.beschreibung: Features of VEHICLE providing journey. Recommended SIRI values based on TPEG are given in SIRI documentation and enumerated in the siri_facilities package.

children.name: VehicleJourneyName
children.beschreibung: For train services with named journeys. Train name, e.g. West Coast Express. If omitted: No train name. Inherited property. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: JourneyNote
children.beschreibung: Additional descriptive text associated with journey. Inherited property.

children.name: PublicContact
children.beschreibung: Contact details for use by members of public. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: PhoneNumber
children.beschreibung: Phone number (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: Url
children.beschreibung: Url for contact (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: OperationsContact
children.beschreibung: Contact details for use by operational staff. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: PhoneNumber
children.beschreibung: Phone number (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: Url
children.beschreibung: Url for contact (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: HeadwayService
children.beschreibung: Whether this is a Headway Service, that is shown as operating at a prescribed interval rather than to a fixed timetable. Default is 'false

children.name: OriginAimedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Timetabled departure time from Origin.

children.name: DestinationAimedArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Timetabled arrival time at Destination.

children.name: FirstOrLastJourney
children.beschreibung: Whether journey is first or last journey of day. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: FormationCondition
children.beschreibung: Information about a change of the formation (e.g. TRAIN composition) or changes of vehicles within the formation. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: FacilityConditionElement
children.beschreibung: Information about a change of Equipment availability at stop or on vehicle that may affect access or use.

children.name: FacilityChangeElement
children.beschreibung: A change to the availaibility of EQUIPMENT. Basic structure defined in the first 1.0 SIRI XSd.

children.name: ControlActionRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a ControlAction having possible consequences on the EstimatedVehicleJourney. Note that if the ControlAction is the master ControlAction of a GroupOfControlActions it is assumed that the refence is valid for all the ControlActions of the group.

children.name: Monitored
children.beschreibung: Whether there is real-time information available for journey. Default is 'true'. It is recommended to specify a MonitoringError if Monitored is set to 'false'.

children.name: MonitoringError
children.beschreibung: If Monitored is 'false', a (list of) reason(s) for non-availability of real-time data. Examples are "GPS", "GPRS", "Radio" etc. MonitoringError must not be used if Monitored is omitted or set to 'true'.

children.name: InCongestion
children.beschreibung: Whether the VEHICLE iis in traffic congestion. If not, present, not known.

children.name: InPanic
children.beschreibung: Whether the panic alarm on the VEHICLE is activated. This may lead to indeterminate predictions. If absent, default is 'false'

children.name: PredictionInaccurate
children.beschreibung: Whether the prediction for a specific stop or the whole journey is considered to be of a useful accuracy or not. Default is 'false', i.e. prediction is considered to be accurate. If prediction is degraded, e.g. because of a situation, PredictionInaccurate is used to indicate a lowered quality of data. Inherited property. PredictionInaccurate can be used in combination with InCongestion, but is more general.

children.name: PredictionInaccurateReason
children.beschreibung: Can be used to inform the passenger about the reason for a change of the prediction (in)accuracy in case PredictionInaccurate is set to 'true'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DataSource
children.beschreibung: System originating real-time data. Can be used to make judgements of relative quality and accuracy compared to other feeds.

children.name: ConfidenceLevel
children.beschreibung: Confidence QUALITY LEVEL of data. Default is 'reliable'

children.name: VehicleLocation
children.beschreibung: Current geospatial location of VEHICLE. Measured to front of vehicle.

children.name: LocationRecordedAtTime
children.beschreibung: Time at which location was recorded. If not present assume that the recorded at time on the containing delivery.

children.name: Bearing
children.beschreibung: Bearing in compass degrees in which VEHICLE is heading.

children.name: ProgressRate
children.beschreibung: Rate of progress of VEHICLE. Default is 'normal'.

children.name: Velocity
children.beschreibung: Velocity of VEHICLE. EIther actual speed or average speed may be used. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: EngineOn
children.beschreibung: Whether the engine of the vehicle is on. Default is 'true' (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: Occupancy
children.beschreibung: An approximate figure of how occupied the journey is after departing from a given stop, e.g. 'manySeatsAvailable' or 'standingRoomOnly'. If omitted: Passenger load is unknown. Occupancies and capacities for individual VEHICLEs, e.g. parts of a COMPOUND TRAIN, can also be specified in more detail for the departure on CALL level.

children.name: Delay
children.beschreibung: Delay of VEHICLE against schedule, to a precision in seconds. Early times are shown as negative values.

children.name: ProgressStatus
children.beschreibung: An arbitrary textual status description of the running of this VEHICLE JOURNEY. (Unbounded 0:* since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: VehicleStatus
children.beschreibung: An classification of the progress state of running of this VEHICLE JOURNEY. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: TrainBlockPart
children.beschreibung: If a VEHICLE JOURNEY is a coupled journey, i.e. comprises several coupled BLOCKparts, there will be a separate delivery for each BLOCKp art and this element will indicate the vehicles that the journey part uses.

children.name: NumberOfBlockParts
children.beschreibung: Total number of BLOCK parts making up the train of which this is part.

children.name: TrainPartRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a train BLOCK part.

children.name: PositionOfTrainBlockPart
children.beschreibung: Description of position of train BLOCK part within Train to guide passengers where to find it. E.g. 'Front four coaches'.

children.name: BlockRef
children.beschreibung: BLOCK that VEHICLE is running.

children.name: CourseOfJourneyRef
children.beschreibung: COURSE OF JOURNEY ('Run') that VEHICLE is running.

children.name: VehicleJourneyRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a VEHICLE JOURNEY.

children.name: VehicleRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a VEHICLE.

children.name: AdditionalVehicleJourneyRef
children.beschreibung: Refercence to other VEHICLE Journeys ((since SIRI 2.0))

children.name: DriverRef
children.beschreibung: A reference to the DRIVER or Crew currently logged in to operate a monitored VEHICLE. May be omitted if real-time data is not available - i.e. it is timetabled data. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DriverName
children.beschreibung: The name oo the Driver or Crew   (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: TrainNumbers
children.beschreibung: TRAIN NUMBERs for journey. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: TrainNumberRef
children.beschreibung: TRAIN NUMBER  assigned to VEHICLE JOURNEY.  +SIRI  2.0

children.name: JourneyParts
children.beschreibung: JOURNEY PARTs making up JOURNEY +SIRIv2.0 e.

children.name: JourneyPartInfo
children.beschreibung: Information about Parts of JOURNEY  (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: JourneyPartRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a JOURNEY part. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: TrainNumberRef
children.beschreibung: Train Number for JOURNEY PART (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: OperatorRef
children.beschreibung: OPERATOR of JOURNEY PART. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: CompoundTrainRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to COMPOUND TRAIN that represents the train formation/composition as a whole (for this JOURNEY PART). (since SIRI 2.1) A journey does always have one or more JOURNEY PARTs for which the train formation/composition remains unchanged.

children.name: FromStopPointRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to the SCHEDULED STOP POINT at which the related JOURNEY PART begins.

children.name: ToStopPointRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to the SCHEDULED STOP POINT at which the related JOURNEY PART ends.

children.name: StartTime
children.beschreibung: Time at which the related JOURNEY PART begins.

children.name: EndTime
children.beschreibung: Time at which the related JOURNEY PART ends.

children.name: TrainElementRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a TRAIN ELEMENT. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: TrainElement
children.beschreibung: An elementary component of a TRAIN, e.g. wagon or locomotive. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: Train
children.beschreibung: A vehicle composed of TRAIN ELEMENTs assembled in a certain order (so called TRAIN COMPONENTs), i.e. wagons assembled together and propelled by a locomotive or one of the wagons. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: CompoundTrain
children.beschreibung: Groups of carriages may be managed as sections by composing TRAINs into a COMPOUND TRAIN, for example if a TRAIN joins (or splits from) another TRAIN. TRAINs within a COMPOUND TRAIN may have different origins and destinations due to joining/splitting. A COMPOUND TRAIN may be stable for one or multiple JOURNEY PARTs and change at a certain STOP POINT due to planned joining/splitting, despatching alterations or a situation.

children.name: RecordedCalls
children.beschreibung: Complete sequence of stops already visited along the route path, in calling order. Only used if observed stop data is being recorded. (SIRI 2.0)

children.name: RecordedCall
children.beschreibung: Ordered sequence of SCHEDULED STOP POINTs called at by the VEHICLE JOURNEY. Only used if observed stop data is being recorded. (SIRI 2.0)

children.name: StopPointRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a SCHEDULED STOP POINT.

children.name: VisitNumber
children.beschreibung: Sequence of visit to SCHEDULED STOP POINT.within VEHICLE JOURNEY. Increases monotonically, but not necessarily sequentially.

children.name: Order
children.beschreibung: For implementations for which the overall Order is not used for VisitNumber, (i.e. if VisitNumberIsOrder is false) then can be used to associate the stop Order as well if useful.

children.name: StopPointName
children.beschreibung: Name of SCHEDULED STOP POINT. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ExtraCall
children.beschreibung: This CALL is an addition to the respective journey in the production timetable or to the previously sent prediction. If omitted: CALL is planned.

children.name: Cancellation
children.beschreibung: This CALL is a cancellation of a previously announced call.

children.name: PredictionInaccurate
children.beschreibung: Whether the prediction for a specific stop or the whole journey is considered to be of a useful accuracy or not. Default is 'false', i.e. prediction is considered to be accurate. If prediction is degraded, e.g. because of a situation, PredictionInaccurate is used to indicate a lowered quality of data. Inherited property. PredictionInaccurate can be used in combination with InCongestion, but is more general.

children.name: PredictionInaccurateReason
children.beschreibung: Can be used to inform the passenger about the reason for a change of the prediction (in)accuracy in case PredictionInaccurate is set to 'true'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: Occupancy
children.beschreibung: An approximate figure of how occupied the journey is after departing from a given stop, e.g. 'manySeatsAvailable' or 'standingRoomOnly'. If omitted: Passenger load is unknown. Occupancies and capacities for individual VEHICLEs, e.g. parts of a COMPOUND TRAIN, can also be specified in more detail for the departure on CALL level.

children.name: TimingPoint
children.beschreibung: Whether the stop is a TIMING POINT. Times for stops that are not timing points are sometimes interpolated crudely from the timing points, and may represent a lower level of accuracy. Default is 'true'.

children.name: BoardingStretch
children.beschreibung: Whether this is a Hail and Ride Stop. Default is 'false'.

children.name: RequestStop
children.beschreibung: Whether Vehicle stops only if requested explicitly by passenger. Default is 'false'.

children.name: OriginDisplay
children.beschreibung: Origin to show for the VEHICLE at the specific stop (vehicle signage), if different to the Origin Name for the full journey. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DestinationDisplay
children.beschreibung: Destination to show for the VEHICLE at the specific stop (vehicle signage), if different to the Destination Name for the full journey.

children.name: CallNote
children.beschreibung: Text annotation that applies to this CALL.

children.name: FormationCondition
children.beschreibung: Information about a change of the formation (e.g. TRAIN composition) or changes of vehicles within the formation. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: FacilityConditionElement
children.beschreibung: Information about a change of Equipment availability at stop or on vehicle that may affect access or use.

children.name: FacilityChangeElement
children.beschreibung: A change to the availaibility of EQUIPMENT. Basic structure defined in the first 1.0 SIRI XSd.

children.name: ControlActionRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a ControlAction having possible consequences on the EstimatedVehicleJourney. Note that if the ControlAction is the master ControlAction of a GroupOfControlActions it is assumed that the refence is valid for all the ControlActions of the group.

children.name: AimedArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Target arrival time of VEHICLE at stop according to latest working timetable.

children.name: ExpectedArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Estimated time of arriival of VEHICLE at stop .

children.name: ActualArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Observed time of arrival of VEHICLE at stop.

children.name: ArrivalStatus
children.beschreibung: Classification of the timeliness of the visit according to a fixed list of values. If not specified, same as DepartureStatus

children.name: ArrivalCancellationReason
children.beschreibung: Text annotation to be used in cases where ArrivalStatus is set to 'cancelled'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalProximityText
children.beschreibung: Arbitrary text string to show to indicate the status of the departure of the VEHICLE for example, Enroute, 5 Km, Approaching. May depend on the policy of the OPERATOR, for example show Approaching if less than 200metres away from stop. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ArrivalPlatformName
children.beschreibung: Bay or platform (QUAY) name to show passenger i.e. expected platform for vehicle to arrive at. Inheritable property. Can be omitted if the same as the DeparturePlatformName If there no arrival platform name separate from the departure platform name, the precedence is: (i) any arrival platform on any related dated timetable element, (ii) any departure platform name on this estimated element; (iii) any departure platform name on any related dated timetable CALL.

children.name: ArrivalBoardingActivity
children.beschreibung: Type of alighting allowed at stop. Default is 'Alighting

children.name: ArrivalStopAssignment
children.beschreibung: Assignment of planned, expected and/or recorded arrival at STOP POINT to a phsyical QUAY (platform). If not given, assume same as for departure. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: ArrivalFormationAssignment
children.beschreibung: Assignment of a TRAIN formation to a physical QUAY (platform or sectors thereof). If not given, assume same as for departure. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalOrientationRelativeToQuay
children.beschreibung: Indication of the direction of travel of the vehicle (e.g. TRAIN formation) with respect to the platform, or more precisely the QUAY. Unbounded to allow multiple languages. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalOperatorRefs
children.beschreibung: OPERATORs of of service up until arrival. May change for departure. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: AimedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Target departure time of VEHICLE from stop according to latest working timetable.

children.name: ExpectedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Estimated time of departure of VEHICLE from stop, most likely taking into account all control actions such as waiting.

children.name: DeparturePlatformName
children.beschreibung: Departure QUAY (bay or platform) name. Default taken from planned timetable.

children.name: ActualDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Observed time of departure of VEHICLE from stop.

children.name: DepartureStatus
children.beschreibung: Classification of the timeliness of the departure part of the CALL, according to a fixed list of values. This may reflect a presentation policy, for example CALLs less than one minute behind target time are still classified as on-time. Applications may use this to guide their own presentation of times.

children.name: DepartureCancellationReason
children.beschreibung: Text annotation to be used in cases where DepartureStatus is set to 'cancelled'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DepartureProximityText
children.beschreibung: Arbitrary text string to show to indicate the status of the departure of the vehicle, for example, "Boarding", "GatesClosed". (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DepartureBoardingActivity
children.beschreibung: Nature of boarding allowed at stop. Default is 'Boarding'.

children.name: DepartureStopAssignment
children.beschreibung: Type for assignment of a SCHEDULED STOP POINT to a physical location, in particular to a QUAY or BOARDING POSITION. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: DepartureFormationAssignment
children.beschreibung: Assignment of a TRAIN formation to a physical QUAY (platform or sectors thereof). (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DepartureOrientationRelativeToQuay
children.beschreibung: Indication of the direction of travel of the vehicle (e.g. TRAIN formation) with respect to the platform, or more precisely the QUAY. Unbounded to allow multiple languages. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: RecordedDepartureOccupancy
children.beschreibung: Actually recorded/counted occupancies of a VEHICLE and reserved seats after departing from a given stop. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: RecordedDepartureCapacities
children.beschreibung: Actually recorded/counted capacities of a VEHICLE after departing from a given stop. Alternative way to communicate occupancy measurements. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DepartureOperatorRefs
children.beschreibung: OPERATORs of service for departure and onwards. May change from that for arrival. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: AimedHeadwayInterval
children.beschreibung: For frequency based services, target interval between vehicles at stop.

children.name: ExpectedHeadwayInterval
children.beschreibung: For frequency based services, expected interval between vehicles at stop.

children.name: ActualHeadwayInterval
children.beschreibung: For frequency based services, observed interval between vehicles at stop.

children.name: IsCompleteStopSequence
children.beschreibung: Whether the above call sequence is complete, i.e. represents every CALL of the SERVICE PATTERN and so can be used to replace a previous call sequence. Default is 'false'.

children.name: EstimatedCalls
children.beschreibung: Complete sequence of stops along the route path, in calling order. Normally this is only the onwards stops from the vehicle's current position.

children.name: EstimatedCall
children.beschreibung: Ordered sequence of SCHEDULED STOP POINTs called at by the VEHICLE JOURNEY. If IsCompleteStopSequence is false, may be just those stops that are altered.

children.name: StopPointRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a SCHEDULED STOP POINT.

children.name: VisitNumber
children.beschreibung: Sequence of visit to SCHEDULED STOP POINT.within VEHICLE JOURNEY. Increases monotonically, but not necessarily sequentially.

children.name: Order
children.beschreibung: For implementations for which the overall Order is not used for VisitNumber, (i.e. if VisitNumberIsOrder is false) then can be used to associate the stop Order as well if useful.

children.name: StopPointName
children.beschreibung: Name of SCHEDULED STOP POINT. (Unbounded since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ExtraCall
children.beschreibung: This CALL is an addition to the respective journey in the production timetable or to the previously sent prediction. If omitted: CALL is planned.

children.name: Cancellation
children.beschreibung: This CALL is a cancellation of a previously announced call.

children.name: PredictionInaccurate
children.beschreibung: Whether the prediction for a specific stop or the whole journey is considered to be of a useful accuracy or not. Default is 'false', i.e. prediction is considered to be accurate. If prediction is degraded, e.g. because of a situation, PredictionInaccurate is used to indicate a lowered quality of data. Inherited property. PredictionInaccurate can be used in combination with InCongestion, but is more general.

children.name: PredictionInaccurateReason
children.beschreibung: Can be used to inform the passenger about the reason for a change of the prediction (in)accuracy in case PredictionInaccurate is set to 'true'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: Occupancy
children.beschreibung: An approximate figure of how occupied the journey is after departing from a given stop, e.g. 'manySeatsAvailable' or 'standingRoomOnly'. If omitted: Passenger load is unknown. Occupancies and capacities for individual VEHICLEs, e.g. parts of a COMPOUND TRAIN, can also be specified in more detail for the departure on CALL level.

children.name: TimingPoint
children.beschreibung: Whether the stop is a TIMING POINT. Times for stops that are not timing points are sometimes interpolated crudely from the timing points, and may represent a lower level of accuracy. Default is 'true'.

children.name: BoardingStretch
children.beschreibung: Whether this is a Hail and Ride Stop. Default is 'false'.

children.name: RequestStop
children.beschreibung: Whether Vehicle stops only if requested explicitly by passenger. Default is 'false'.

children.name: OriginDisplay
children.beschreibung: Origin to show for the VEHICLE at the specific stop (vehicle signage), if different to the Origin Name for the full journey. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DestinationDisplay
children.beschreibung: Destination to show for the VEHICLE at the specific stop (vehicle signage), if different to the Destination Name for the full journey.

children.name: CallNote
children.beschreibung: Text annotation that applies to this CALL.

children.name: FormationCondition
children.beschreibung: Information about a change of the formation (e.g. TRAIN composition) or changes of vehicles within the formation. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: FacilityConditionElement
children.beschreibung: Information about a change of Equipment availability at stop or on vehicle that may affect access or use.

children.name: FacilityChangeElement
children.beschreibung: A change to the availaibility of EQUIPMENT. Basic structure defined in the first 1.0 SIRI XSd.

children.name: ControlActionRef
children.beschreibung: Reference to a ControlAction having possible consequences on the EstimatedVehicleJourney. Note that if the ControlAction is the master ControlAction of a GroupOfControlActions it is assumed that the refence is valid for all the ControlActions of the group.

children.name: AimedArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Target arrival time of VEHICLE at stop according to latest working timetable.

children.name: ExpectedArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Estimated time of arriival of VEHICLE at stop .

children.name: LatestExpectedArrivalTime
children.beschreibung: Latest time at which a VEHICLE will arrive at stop. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ExpectedArrivalPredictionQuality
children.beschreibung: Prediction quality, either as approximate level, or more quantitative percentile range of predictions that will fall within a given range of times. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ArrivalPredictionUnknown
children.beschreibung: If the producer is (temporarily) not able to deliver real-time predictions (e.g. because of a connection loss), he has various options (and combinations of them) to inform the consumer: (i) set Monitored to 'false' (ii) transmit ExpectedArrivalTime together with "PredictionInaccurate=true" (iii) drop/omit ExpectedArrivalTime (iv) set ArrivalStatus to 'noReport' However, this might introduce ambiguity: e.g. option (iii) might be interpreted as "on time" by one consumer, but also as "indefinite delay" by another consumer. To avoid this, the producer should transmit xxxPredictionUnknown instead of any expected times. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalStatus
children.beschreibung: Classification of the timeliness of the visit according to a fixed list of values. If not specified, same as DepartureStatus.

children.name: ArrivalCancellationReason
children.beschreibung: Text annotation to be used in cases where ArrivalStatus is set to 'cancelled'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalProximityText
children.beschreibung: Arbitrary text string to show to indicate the status of the departure of the VEHICLE for example, "Enroute", "5 Km", "Approaching". May depend on the policy of the OPERATOR, for example show "Approaching" if less than 200metres away from stop. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ArrivalPlatformName
children.beschreibung: Bay or platform (QUAY) name to show passenger i.e. expected platform for vehicle to arrive at. Inheritable property. Can be omitted if the same as the DeparturePlatformName If there no arrival platform name separate from the departure platform name, the precedence is: (i) any arrival platform on any related dated timetable element, (ii) any departure platform name on this estimated element; (iii) any departure platform name on any related dated timetable CALL.

children.name: ArrivalBoardingActivity
children.beschreibung: Type of alighting allowed at stop. Default is 'Alighting'.

children.name: ArrivalStopAssignment
children.beschreibung: Assignment of planned, expected and/or recorded arrival at STOP POINT to a phsyical QUAY (platform). If not given, assume same as for departure. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: ArrivalFormationAssignment
children.beschreibung: Assignment of a TRAIN formation to a physical QUAY (platform or sectors thereof). If not given, assume same as for departure. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalOrientationRelativeToQuay
children.beschreibung: Indication of the direction of travel of the vehicle (e.g. TRAIN formation) with respect to the platform, or more precisely the QUAY. Unbounded to allow multiple languages. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ArrivalOperatorRefs
children.beschreibung: OPERATORs of of service up until arrival. May change for departure. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: AimedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Target departure time of VEHICLE from stop according to latest working timetable.

children.name: ExpectedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Estimated time of departure of VEHICLE from stop, most likely taking into account all control actions such as waiting.

children.name: ProvisionalExpectedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Expected departure time of VEHICLE without waiting time due to operational actions. For people at stop this would normally be shown if different from Expected departure time. So if servcie decides not to wait may leave earler than expected departure time (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: EarliestExpectedDepartureTime
children.beschreibung: Earliest time at which VEHICLE may leave the stop. Used to secure connections. Used for passenger announcements. Passengers must be at boarding point by this time to be sure of catching VEHICLE. i.e. "Vehicle will not leave before this time" - may be revised from original aimed time. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ExpectedDeparturePredictionQuality
children.beschreibung: Prediction quality, either as approximate level, or more quantitative percentile range of predictions that will fall within a given range of times. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DeparturePredictionUnknown
children.beschreibung: If the producer is (temporarily) not able to deliver real-time predictions (e.g. because of a connection loss), he has various options (and combinations of them) to inform the consumer: (i) set Monitored to 'false' (ii) transmit ExpectedDepartureTime together with "PredictionInaccurate=true" (iii) drop/omit ExpectedDepartureTime (iv) set DepartureStatus to 'noReport' However, this might introduce ambiguity: e.g. option (iii) might be interpreted as "on time" by one consumer, but also as "indefinite delay" by another consumer. To avoid this, the producer should transmit xxxPredictionUnknown instead of any expected times. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: AimedLatestPassengerAccessTime
children.beschreibung: Latest target time at which a PASSENGER should aim to arrive at the STOP PLACE containing the stop. This time may be earlier than the VEHICLE departure times and may include time for processes such as checkin, security, etc.(As specified by CHECK CONSTRAINT DELAYs in the underlying data). If absent assume to be the same as Earliest expected departure time. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: ExpectedLatestPassengerAccessTime
children.beschreibung: Latest expected time at which a PASSENGER should aim to arrive at the STOP PLACE containing the stop. This time may be earlier than the VEHICLE departure times and may include time for processes such as checkin, security, etc.(As specified by CHECK CONSTRAINT DELAYs in the underlying data). If absent assume to be the same as Earliest expected departure time. (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: AimedHeadwayInterval
children.beschreibung: For frequency based services, target interval between vehicles at stop.

children.name: ExpectedHeadwayInterval
children.beschreibung: For frequency based services, expected interval between vehicles at stop.

children.name: DistanceFromStop
children.beschreibung: Distance of VEHICLE from stop of CALL as measured along ROUTE track. Only shown if detail level is 'calls' or higher. Positive value denotes distance before stop. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: NumberOfStopsAway
children.beschreibung: Count of stops along SERVICE PATTERN between current position of VEHICLE and stop of CALL as measured along ROUTE track. Only shown if detail level is 'calls' or higher. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: DepartureStatus
children.beschreibung: Classification of the timeliness of the departure part of the CALL, according to a fixed list of values. This may reflect a presentation policy, for example CALLs less than one minute behind target time are still classified as on-time. Applications may use this to guide their own presentation of times.

children.name: DepartureCancellationReason
children.beschreibung: Text annotation to be used in cases where DepartureStatus is set to 'cancelled'. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DepartureProximityText
children.beschreibung: Arbitrary text string to show to indicate the status of the departure of the vehicle, for example, "Boarding", "GatesClosed". (since SIRI 2.0)

children.name: DeparturePlatformName
children.beschreibung: Departure QUAY (bay or platform) name. Default taken from planned timetable.

children.name: DepartureBoardingActivity
children.beschreibung: Nature of boarding allowed at stop. Default is 'Boarding'.

children.name: DepartureStopAssignment
children.beschreibung: Type for assignment of a SCHEDULED STOP POINT to a physical location, in particular to a QUAY or BOARDING POSITION. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: DepartureFormationAssignment
children.beschreibung: Assignment of a TRAIN formation to a physical QUAY (platform or sectors thereof). (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DepartureOrientationRelativeToQuay
children.beschreibung: Indication of the direction of travel of the vehicle (e.g. TRAIN formation) with respect to the platform, or more precisely the QUAY. Unbounded to allow multiple languages. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ExpectedDepartureOccupancy
children.beschreibung: Expected/Predicted real-time occupancies of a VEHICLE and reservations after departing from a given stop. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: ExpectedDepartureCapacities
children.beschreibung: Expected/Predicted real-time capacities (number of available seats) of a VEHICLE after departing from a given stop. Alternative way to communicate occupancy measurements. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: RecordedDepartureOccupancy
children.beschreibung: Actually recorded/counted occupancies of a VEHICLE and reserved seats after departing from a given stop. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: RecordedDepartureCapacities
children.beschreibung: Actually recorded/counted capacities of a VEHICLE after departing from a given stop. Alternative way to communicate occupancy measurements. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: DepartureOperatorRefs
children.beschreibung: OPERATORs of service for departure and onwards. May change from that for arrival. (since SIRI 2.0).

children.name: JourneyRelations
children.beschreibung: Relations of the journey with other journeys, e.g., in case a joining/splitting takes place or the journey substitutes for another one etc.

children.name: JourneyRelationType
children.beschreibung: Specifies the type of the relation, e.g., joining, splitting, replacement etc. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: CallInfo
children.beschreibung: Information about the stop at which the JOURNEY is related to another JOURNEY. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: JourneyParts
children.beschreibung: Information about the JOURNEY PARTs for which the JOURNEY has a JOURNEY RELATION. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: RelatedJourney
children.beschreibung: Refers to the JOURNEY to which the current JOURNEY is related. (since SIRI 2.1)

children.name: EstimatedServiceJourneyInterchange
children.beschreibung: Connection parameters for a monitored SERVICE JOURNEY INTERCHANGE between a feeder and distributor journey. SIRI 2.0
